body.text: The entity checks out. What is missing is who owns it: the filing names no natural person, so ownership is unverified and the screening covers only the entity and JOSHUA GEE. A PLLC also requires a licensed practitioner, and no licence has been checked.

followUps.text: Collect a beneficial ownership certification from KAIROS PHYSICAL THERAPY PLLC naming every member holding 25 percent or more and every controlling person, with each member's New York physical therapy licence number.

Search the NPI registry for JOSHUA GEE and confirm the record is a Physical Therapist at 801 Madison Ave, then check the same name against the New York Office of the Professions for a current licence. Repeat for every further member the certification names.
Screen each member named on the certification through watchlist, sanctions, PEP and adverse media. Only JOSHUA GEE and the entity itself have been screened so far.

Establish who is behind KAIROS 801 LLC and J.L.W. INVESTORS, LTD. Both link to this business by shared mailing address only, and KAIROS 801 LLC shares the Bayside address as well as the practice, so a common owner is likely but not on the record.
